_comment: Doctor config for this brain (SPEC 5.3). Tunable values only, no logic, no absolute paths: write ${ROOT}-relative paths where a path is needed. Every key names its reader in _readers; a key that nothing reads is dead config, and the Doctor reports it. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_derived: Not keys any more, derived from the pointer: root, stateDir (<brain>/state), recordsDir (<brain>/records), the root settings paths (<root>/.claude/settings.json + settings.local.json) and the fence log path (~/.claude/fence-log.txt).

_readers.schema: doctor.mjs - must be 1; a mismatch is the MIGRATE finding
_readers.surveyStrict: report.mjs - when true, SURVEY findings of severity fail turn the verdict RED (exit 1)
_readers.maxDepth: repos.mjs - how many folders deep to look for .git under root
_readers.parallelGit: repos.mjs - how many repositories the sweep reads at a time; 1 reads them one after another (same result, slower)
_readers.excludePathParts: repos.mjs - a repo whose path contains one of these is not swept at all
_readers.archivedPathParts: repos.mjs - a repo whose path contains one of these is listed but not judged
_readers.ownerRemotePatterns: repos.mjs - a remote URL containing none of these is FOREIGN
_readers.frozenPaths: repos.mjs (frozenDirty finding) / enforcement.mjs (soft_deny count) / hooks/guard.mjs (path deny)
_readers.unversionedMaxDepth: repos.mjs - how deep the no-git-at-all sweep walks
_readers.unversionedIgnorePathParts: repos.mjs - folders deliberately outside git; add one only with a reason written next to it
_readers.secretExceptions: repos.mjs (tracked secret scan) / hooks/guard.mjs (staging and write rules) - absolute or ${ROOT}-relative file paths
_readers.acceptedExceptions: doctor.mjs - (path, kind) pairs that are reported but not counted; each needs since and reason
_readers.entryPointSnapshots: doctor.mjs - live file vs byte snapshot, compared after CRLF->LF
_readers.lawClaim: tools/vcs/law-claim.mjs (the commit check, VCS-23) - extraFiles: more repo-relative paths that count as law files; trailer: the waiver line's name; minReason: shortest reason accepted
_readers.categories: survey.mjs - folders: top-level folders under root that hold projects; a repository under any other first folder is reported as outsideCategory (never the root, the brain or the root .claude folder). since: ISO date; a stray born before it is reported, one born on or after it is a fail. Empty folders: the check is off
_readers.readCeilingBytes: hooks/guard.mjs rule 6 (the read check, DES-03) - a write that grows a source file past this many bytes (about one Read) tells the agent once per file per session to list the file's subjects; it never asks for a split for size; 0 turns it off
_readers.readCeilingExempt: hooks/guard.mjs rule 6 - path globs the read check skips; only * is a wildcard (** is the same), ${ROOT} and ${BRAIN} expand
_readers.sourceExtensions: hooks/guard.mjs rules 5 and 6 - which extensions count as source for the manifest rule and the read check; docs, config and data are not source
_readers.stopDocs: hooks/stop.mjs - file names that count as documents for the Stop card (DES-07); a file in a docs/ folder inside the repository counts too, unless its extension is a source extension
_readers.stopFromGit: hooks/stop.mjs - true: the Stop card reads the turn's changes from git (commits made and files written since the prompt), so a file a command changed is counted; false: Edit and Write calls only
_readers.stopBudgetSeconds: hooks/stop.mjs - the Stop card's time budget in seconds, under the host's 20 s Stop timeout; past it no more repositories are read from git and the card names them; a value outside (0, 18] keeps the default 15

_acceptedExceptionsExample.reason: Vendored third-party tree. Not my work; nothing of mine is lost if it goes. Kinds: noRemote, foreignRemote, shallow, unpushed, frozenDirty, emptyRepo, noGitattributes, noGitAtAll, trackedSecret.
